newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon on HMO stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon on HMO stocks.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said analyst Robert Hoehn advised investors with a short-term, six-month time horizon to reduce weightings of health maintenance organization stocks in their portfolios.
-- The analyst downgraded United Healthcare Corp to buy from strong buy and Humana Inc to hold from buy, the brokerage said in a report.
-- Hoehn said "no solid evidence" of stronger 1997 pricing will be seen until "at least" the time when first quarter results are released.
-- "More importantly, we will not be convinced that companies have regained control of medical costs until second quarter results are released, starting late in July," the report said.
-- He said, however, he remained "optimistic" about the long-term outlook for the industry.
-- United Health was off 1/8 at 46-5/8 and Humana dipped 1/4 to 18-3/4.
-- Among other HMOs, Oxford Health Plans Inc fell 1-1/8 to 58-7/8 and PacifiCare Health Systems Inc lost 1-1/2 to 77. WellPoint Health Networks Inc was flat at 35 and Coventry Corp rose 1/8 to 10.
